UpstreamDrift is the implementation authority for the control-affine decompositions
AffineDrift motivates. This page records **what the code does at one commit**, not
every narrative shortcut on this site. Every UpstreamDrift link below is pinned to
[`ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/tree/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0)
(`main` on 2026-11-16, read for issue #5620). A statement that the code does not define
something means it was not found at that commit; it is not a claim about later commits.

How each statement was established:

- **Read** means the cited lines were read. Nothing was executed.
- **Run** means the snippet in [Runnable Examples](#minimal-usage) was executed against that commit
  with MuJoCo 3.3.4 and NumPy 2.5.1 on 2026-11-16. These scripts are not UpstreamDrift tests.
- Drake, Pinocchio, OpenSim, MyoSuite and JaxSim were not installed in the environment used
  for this page, so their rows are **read** only.

For array layouts, frames, and quaternion order when moving state between engines, see
the [UpstreamDrift Conventions Reference](upstreamdrift-conventions.html). AffineDrift's
provider catalog is [Engines and Runtime Support](../models/programming/engines.html).

## Optional Dependencies {#dependencies}

Only MuJoCo is a core dependency ([`pyproject.toml` L33][pyproject-core]). Every other engine
or backend is an optional extra, and a missing extra surfaces as an import or availability error:

| Engine or backend | Extra and pin (read) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MuJoCo | core: `mujoco>=3.6.0,<4.0.0` | Also the `mujoco` simulation backend |
| Drake | `drake>=1.57.0,<1.59.0` ([L153][pyproject-extras]) | |
| Pinocchio | `pin>=2.6.0,<5.0.0` plus `meshcat`, `pin-pink` ([L158][pyproject-extras]) | |
| OpenSim | `opensim>=4.4.0,<5.0.0` ([L245][pyproject-extras]) | Experimental tier |
| MyoSuite | `myosuite>=2.0.0`, `gymnasium>=0.29.0` ([L246][pyproject-extras]) | Experimental tier |
| JaxSim | `jaxsim==0.9.0` ([L163][pyproject-extras]) | Linux-only per its [README][jaxsim-readme] |
| `mjx` backend | `mujoco-mjx`, `jax`, `jaxlib` ([L171][pyproject-extras]) | |
| `mjwarp` backend | `mujoco-warp`, `warp-lang`; CUDA GPU ([L258][pyproject-extras]) | |
| Pendulum, putting green | none beyond core | Analytical engines |

## The `PhysicsEngine` Contract {#physics-engine-contract}

[`PhysicsEngine`][iface] is a `runtime_checkable` `Protocol` that composes
[`SimulationInterface`][sim-if] (load, step, state I/O, capabilities) and
[`DynamicsInterface`][dyn-if] (mass matrix, bias, Jacobian, drift and control). State machine from the
interface docstring: **uninitialized, then `load_*`, then initialized**; `reset` returns to `t = 0`.

Notation in the table: `n_q` is the length of `q`, `n_v` the length of `v` and of every acceleration,
`n_u` the length of the control vector `u`. These differ: a free joint has `n_q = n_v + 1`, and a
model with fewer actuators than DOFs has `n_u < n_v`. Units are those the docstrings state.

| Method | Signature (as declared) | Shapes and units | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model_name` (property) | `-> str` | Empty string when nothing is loaded | [L22-L34][sim-if-name] |
| `load_from_path` | `(path: str) -> None` | Docstring lists `.xml .urdf .sdf .osim`; raises `FileNotFoundError`, `ValueError`, `StateError` | [L44-L67][sim-if-load] |
| `load_from_string` | `(content: str, extension: str \| None = None) -> None` | Raises `ValueError` on empty content | [L69-L88][sim-if-load] |
| `reset` | `() -> None` | Docstring: `t = 0`, `q = q0`, `v = 0` | [L90-L104][sim-if-reset] |
| `step` | `(dt: float \| None = None) -> None` | `dt` in s, must be `> 0`; `None` means "the model's default timestep" | [L106-L126][sim-if-step] |
| `forward` | `() -> None` | Updates derived quantities, time and `(q, v)` unchanged | [L128-L146][sim-if-step] |
| `get_state` | `() -> tuple[ndarray, ndarray]` | `q (n_q,)`, `v (n_v,)`, finite | [L148-L168][sim-if-state] |
| `set_state` | `(q, v) -> None` | `q (n_q,)`, `v (n_v,)`; `ValueError` on mismatch | [L170-L191][sim-if-state] |
| `set_control` | `(u: ndarray) -> None` | `u (n_u,)` actuator commands | [L193-L212][sim-if-state] |
| `get_time` | `() -> float` | Seconds, `>= 0` | [L214-L230][sim-if-state] |
| `get_capabilities` | `() -> EngineCapabilities` | Default reports `NONE` for every optional feature | [L270-L301][sim-if-caps] |
| `compute_mass_matrix` | `() -> ndarray` | `(n_v, n_v)`, contract says symmetric positive definite | [L17-L37][dyn-if-mass] |
| `compute_bias_forces` | `() -> ndarray` | `(n_v,)`, "Coriolis, centrifugal and gravity" | [L39-L56][dyn-if-mass] |
| `compute_gravity_forces` | `() -> ndarray` | `(n_v,)` | [L58-L75][dyn-if-mass] |
| `compute_inverse_dynamics` | `(qacc) -> ndarray` | `qacc (n_v,)` in, generalized force `(n_v,)` out | [L77-L101][dyn-if-mass] |
| `compute_jacobian` | `(body_name: str) -> dict[str, ndarray] \| None` | `linear (3, n_v)`, `angular (3, n_v)`, `spatial` stacked `[angular; linear]` | [L103-L124][dyn-if-mass], [order][spatial-order] |
| `compute_contact_forces` | `() -> ndarray` | `(3,)` force or `(6,)` wrench; the default returns zeros | [L126-L141][dyn-if-mass] |
| `compute_drift_acceleration` | `() -> ndarray` | `(n_v,)` in rad/s² or m/s² | [L145-L175][dyn-if-drift] |
| `compute_control_acceleration` | `(tau) -> ndarray` | `tau (n_v,)` in N·m or N; result `(n_v,)` | [L177-L215][dyn-if-drift] |
| `compute_control_acceleration_at_state` | `(q, tau) -> ndarray` | Control term at configuration `q`; default delegates to a shared helper | [L217-L231][dyn-if-drift] |
| `compute_gravity_only_acceleration` | `(q) -> ndarray` | Legacy diagnostic at `v = 0`, `u = 0` | [L233-L243][dyn-if-drift] |
| `compute_ztcf` | `(q, v) -> ndarray` | Acceleration with applied torque zero at `(q, v)`, `(n_v,)` | [L247-L298][dyn-if-drift] |
| `compute_zvcf` | `(q) -> ndarray` | **Deprecated shim**, see [below](#physicsengine-counterfactual-names) | [L300-L321][dyn-if-drift] |
| `set_shaft_properties`, `get_shaft_state` | `(length, EI_profile, mass_profile, damping_ratio=0.02) -> bool`; `() -> dict \| None` | Optional; the default returns `False` / `None` | [L327-L376][dyn-if-drift] |
| `save_checkpoint`, `restore_checkpoint`, `engine_type` | from `Checkpointable` | Signatures live in `checkpoint.py`, which was not read for this page | [interface docstring][iface] |

**Bias and torque.** The inverse-dynamics docstring states `tau = M(q) qacc + C(q,v) v + g(q)`,
so the bias `h` from `compute_bias_forces` satisfies `M a + h = tau`. Drift and control split
the acceleration `a`, not the torque.

### Where Implementations Deviate From the Declared Contract

These were read in the engine sources; none was run unless the row says so.

| Item | Declared | What the code does | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compute_jacobian` for an unknown body | Returns `None` | MuJoCo and Pinocchio raise `KeyError` | [MuJoCo L721-L726][mj-jac], [Pinocchio L545-L551][pin-jac] |
| `set_state` refreshes derived quantities | "via `forward()`" | MuJoCo and Pinocchio call `forward`; Drake only sets positions and velocities | [MuJoCo L286-L308][mj-state], [Pinocchio L389-L403][pin-state], [Drake L279-L288][drake-state] |
| `set_control(u)` length | `n_u` | MuJoCo checks `model.nu`; Pinocchio requires `n_v`; OpenSim checks `getNumControls()`; MyoSuite writes `ctrl` only if the lengths match and otherwise silently ignores it | [MuJoCo L310-L323][mj-state], [Pinocchio L405-L414][pin-state], [OpenSim L350-L385][os-control], [MyoSuite L106-L129][myo-core] |
| `compute_gravity_forces` | `(n_v,)` | MyoSuite returns an empty array | [L60-L63][myo-dyn] |
| `load_from_path` takes a file | File path | MyoSuite takes a Gym environment ID; the pendulum ignores the path; Pinocchio warns unless the path ends in `.urdf` | [MyoSuite L71-L87][myo-init], [Pendulum L101-L111][pend-load], [Pinocchio L163-L177][pin-load] |
| `load_from_string` | Supported | MyoSuite raises `RuntimeError`; the pendulum ignores the content | [MyoSuite L109-L115][myo-init], [Pendulum L113-L119][pend-load] |
| `step(dt)` honors `dt` | `dt` advances time | MyoSuite logs a warning and ignores a `dt` that differs from the model timestep, then calls `env.step(action)`; the putting-green engine advances time only and samples a precomputed trajectory | [MyoSuite L35-L58][myo-core], [Putting green L125-L131][putt-step] |
| `compute_bias_forces` content | Coriolis, centrifugal, gravity | The pendulum also adds viscous damping `d(q, v)`; MuJoCo returns `qfrc_bias` | [Pendulum L199-L215][pend-bias], [MuJoCo L531-L538][mj-bias] |

## Runnable Examples {#minimal-usage}

All paths are relative to an UpstreamDrift checkout at the pinned commit, run with the repository
root on `PYTHONPATH`. The three scripts in this section were executed; the output quoted is what they printed.

### Pendulum Engine (Run)

The analytical double-pendulum engine has no optional dependency, is initialized on construction,
and ignores `load_from_path` ([L45-L70][pend-init], [L101-L111][pend-load]). A test that exercises the same
calls is
[`tests/engines/physics_engines/test_pendulum_engine.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0/tests/engines/physics_engines/test_pendulum_engine.py).

```python
import numpy as np
from src.engines.physics_engines.pendulum.python.pendulum_physics_engine import (
    PendulumPhysicsEngine,
)

engine = PendulumPhysicsEngine()
engine.reset()
engine.set_state(np.array([0.3, 0.2]), np.zeros(2))   # q = [theta1, theta2] in rad
q, v = engine.get_state()                              # shapes (2,), (2,)
a_drift = engine.compute_drift_acceleration()          # [-4.66346321, 4.19728339] rad/s^2
a_ctrl = engine.compute_control_acceleration(np.array([1.0, 0.5]))  # [0.07656478, 1.94276722]
engine.step(0.001)    # get_time() -> 0.001
engine.step()         # no dt: advances 0.01 s, so get_time() -> 0.011
```

### MuJoCo Engine, Free Chain and Closed Loop (Run)

This script builds a two-link hinge chain with joint damping and two motors, loads it with
`load_from_string`, and compares the engine's control term against `M^-1 tau` with and without an
active `connect` equality constraint (tip pinned to a world site). It is not an UpstreamDrift test;
the related UpstreamDrift unit tests are in
[`tests/unit/engines/mujoco/test_drift_control.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0/tests/unit/engines/mujoco/test_drift_control.py).

```python
import numpy as np
from src.engines.physics_engines.mujoco.python.mujoco_humanoid_golf.physics_engine import (
    MuJoCoPhysicsEngine,
)

LINKS = """
<body name="l1" pos="0 0 1">
  <joint name="j1" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="0.1"/>
  <geom type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0 0 -0.5" size="0.02" mass="1"/>
  <body name="l2" pos="0 0 -0.5">
    <joint name="j2" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="0.1"/>
    <geom type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0 0 -0.5" size="0.02" mass="1"/>
    <site name="tip" pos="0 0 -0.5"/>
  </body>
</body>"""

def model_xml(extra_site="", equality=""):
    return ('<mujoco><option timestep="0.002" integrator="RK4"/>'
            f"<worldbody>{extra_site}{LINKS}</worldbody>"
            '<actuator><motor joint="j1"/><motor joint="j2"/></actuator>'
            f"{equality}</mujoco>")

def load(xml, q0):
    e = MuJoCoPhysicsEngine()
    e.load_from_string(xml, "xml")
    e.set_state(np.array(q0), np.zeros(2))
    return e

q0, tau = [0.4, 0.3], np.array([2.0, -1.0])

# Free chain: no contact, no equality constraint.
e = load(model_xml(), q0)
c = e.compute_control_acceleration(tau)
m = np.linalg.solve(e.compute_mass_matrix(), tau)
print(np.abs(c - m).max())            # 3.6e-15: control equals M^-1 tau

# Closed loop: pin the tip to a world site placed at the tip position for q0.
probe = load(model_xml(), q0)
tip = probe.get_data().site_xpos[probe.get_model().site("tip").id]
site = f'<site name="pin" pos="{tip[0]} {tip[1]} {tip[2]}"/>'
eq = '<equality><connect site1="tip" site2="pin"/></equality>'
e = load(model_xml(site, eq), q0)
d = e.compute_drift_acceleration()
c = e.compute_control_acceleration(tau)
print(np.abs(c - m).max())                                       # 64.77: control differs from M^-1 tau
print(np.abs(d + c - e._constrained_forward_acceleration(tau)).max())  # 1.1e-14: sum is a_full(tau)
print(np.abs(e.compute_control_acceleration_at_state(np.array(q0), tau) - m).max())  # 0.0
```

The same session confirmed that in the free chain `compute_drift_acceleration()` differs from
`-M^-1 compute_bias_forces()` by exactly `-M^-1 diag(0.1) v`, that is, joint damping is part of
MuJoCo drift. `_constrained_forward_acceleration` is a private helper, used here only to check the identity.

### `ode` Simulation Backend (Run)

For rollouts without loading a `PhysicsEngine`, the `ode` backend wraps the analytical club
model ([README L55-L67][sb-readme-usage]). Executed output: `trace.num_steps` is `201` and
`trace.final_state().v` is `[0. 0.]`, because the default model starts at rest. Tests that call
`make_backend("ode", ...)` include
[`tests/research/test_double_pendulum_attribution.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0/tests/research/test_double_pendulum_attribution.py).

```python
from src.shared.python.simulation_backends import GolfModelParams, make_backend

backend = make_backend("ode", GolfModelParams.default())
trace = backend.rollout(controls=None, horizon=200, dt=0.005)  # always pass dt explicitly
```

### Sketches for the Other Engines (Not Run)

These are patterns, not verified programs. Each engine's behavior is read from the cited source, and
UpstreamDrift tests that exercise the same methods are linked so a reader can run them.

- **Drake:** `DrakePhysicsEngine(time_step=0.001)`, then `load_from_path("model.urdf")` or `load_from_string(urdf, "urdf")`,
  then `set_state`, `compute_drift_acceleration`, `compute_control_acceleration(tau)`
  ([constructor][drake-init], [loading][drake-load]). Tests:
  [`tests/unit/test_drake_physics_engine.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0/tests/unit/test_drake_physics_engine.py).
- **Pinocchio:** `PinocchioPhysicsEngine()`, `load_from_string(urdf, "urdf")` or `load_from_path("model.urdf")`; `q` has length
  `model.nq`, `v` and `tau` have length `model.nv`; `step(dt, integrator="semi_implicit")` overrides the default `"rk4"`
  ([load][pin-load], [step][pin-step]). Tests:
  [`tests/unit/pinocchio/test_pinocchio_physics_engine.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0/tests/unit/engines/pinocchio/test_pinocchio_physics_engine.py).
- **OpenSim:** `OpenSimPhysicsEngine()`, `load_from_path("model.osim")`; `get_state` returns coordinate values and speeds
  ([load][os-load]). The constructor warns that the engine is experimental. Tests:
  [`tests/unit/test_opensim_physics_engine.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0/tests/unit/test_opensim_physics_engine.py).
- **MyoSuite:** `MyoSuitePhysicsEngine()`, `load_from_path("<gym-env-id>")` with a registered environment ID such as
  `myoElbowPose1D6MRandom-v0` (the class docstring's example); `step` takes the last `set_control` action and ignores `dt`
  ([load][myo-init], [step][myo-core]). Tests:
  [`tests/unit/engines/myosuite/test_myosuite_physics_engine.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0/tests/unit/engines/myosuite/test_myosuite_physics_engine.py).
- **JaxSim:** `JaxSimBackend` exposes `compute_drift_acceleration` and `compute_control_acceleration(tau)` with `tau` of
  shape `(6 + dofs,)` (floating base first); it defines no `compute_ztcf` or `compute_zvcf`
  ([L390-L404][jax-dyn]). Tests:
  [`tests/unit/engines/test_jaxsim_backend.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/ca9d8887f2ed46de484b64615dd4a50148e07bd0/tests/unit/engines/test_jaxsim_backend.py).
- **Putting green:** `SharedPuttingEngine()` is a two-DOF point-mass ball model; `q = [x, y]` and `v` are in m and m/s
  ([drift][putt-dyn]).

## What Is Inside Drift and Control? {#drift-control-semantics}

The interface declares drift as passive acceleration with actuation zero and control as the part
due to applied `tau`, with the contract `a_drift + a_control = a_full`
([L145-L215][dyn-if-drift]). **The code does not compute the same quantity in every engine.**

| Engine | Drift (code path) | Contact and constraint forces in drift | Damping and passive forces in drift | Control (code path) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **MuJoCo** | `mj_forward` with `ctrl`, `qfrc_applied`, `xfrc_applied` zeroed; returns `qacc` ([L611-L630][mj-drift], [L663-L685][mj-drift]) | **Yes**: docstring says active constraint and contact forces are included | **Yes** (run): joint damping is included | `a_full(tau) - a_drift`, where `a_full` applies `tau` as `qfrc_applied` with `ctrl` zeroed ([L632-L661][mj-drift]) |
| **Drake** | `-M^-1 * bias`, bias from `CalcInverseDynamics` at zero acceleration with gravity as the only external force ([L621-L647][drake-drift]) | **No**: none appears in this path; contact acts only inside the simulator advance | **No** damping term is added in this path | `M^-1 tau` ([L649-L671][drake-drift]) |
| **Pinocchio** | `aba(q, v, 0)` ([L579-L593][pin-drift]) | **No**: no contact model in this path; `compute_contact_forces` returns zeros unless samples are injected | Not read; no damping term appears | `aba(q, v, tau) - aba(q, v, 0)`, which is `M^-1 tau` ([L600-L621][pin-drift]) |
| **OpenSim** | `-M^-1 * ID(q, u, 0)` with `InverseDynamicsSolver` ([L771-L788][os-drift], [L476-L483][os-bias]) | Not read | The solver "includes the model's own forces"; the capability docstring says drift "keeps the model's forces at the state's muscle activations" ([L97-L115][os-caps], [L503-L525][os-bias]) | `M^-1 tau` ([L790-L811][os-drift]) |
| **MyoSuite** | `ctrl` zeroed, `sim.forward()`, returns `qacc`; `qfrc_applied` and `xfrc_applied` untouched ([L29-L45][myo-drift]) | **Yes**, same MuJoCo forward pass | Same as MuJoCo (read) | `M^-1 tau` with `tau` a generalized force `(n_v,)`, unrelated to the muscle `ctrl` ([L47-L60][myo-drift]) |
| **Pendulum** | `-M^-1 (C v + g + d)` ([L243-L263][pend-dyn]) | N/A | **Yes**: viscous damping `d`, defaults 0.4 and 0.25 N·m·s/rad ([constants][pend-damp]) | `M^-1 tau` ([L265-L296][pend-dyn]) |
| **Putting green** | Slope plus rolling friction acceleration ([L216-L220][putt-dyn]) | Rolling friction yes | Rolling friction | `tau / m` ([L222-L226][putt-dyn]) |
| **JaxSim** | `M^-1 (-bias)` ([L390-L395][jax-dyn]) | Not read | Not read | `M^-1 tau`, `tau` shape `(6 + dofs,)` ([L397-L404][jax-dyn]) |
| **Simscape adapter** | Raises `NotImplementedError` ([L702-L722][simscape-drift], [L1169-L1172][simscape-drift]) | N/A | N/A | Raises `NotImplementedError` |

### When Does `a_drift + a_control` Equal the Full Acceleration?

"Full acceleration" has to be named, because two different things are called that.

| Engine | Sum versus the engine's own definition of `a_full` | Sum versus `M^-1 (tau - h)` | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **MuJoCo** `compute_control_acceleration` | **Exact by construction**: control is defined as `a_full(tau) - a_drift`. Run: residual 1.1e-14 with an active `connect` constraint | Not equal when constraints or contacts are active; equal in the free chain (3.6e-15) | Run |
| **MuJoCo** `compute_control_acceleration_at_state` | Not that identity: returns `M^-1 tau` at `q` with `v = 0`, even with constraints (run: 0.0 difference from `M^-1 tau`) | Equal | Run |
| **Drake, Pinocchio, OpenSim, JaxSim, pendulum** | Algebraically `M^-1 (tau - bias)`, if `bias` is the same one used for drift | Equal | Read |
| **MyoSuite** | **Not guaranteed**: drift comes from a constrained forward pass while control is the unconstrained `M^-1 tau`; no `a_full` is defined in the mixin | Not applicable | Read, not run |

Two consequences follow. First, a MuJoCo drift on a model with a grip weld, ground contact or
joint damping is not the drift of Drake or Pinocchio on the same model, so cross-engine drift
comparisons need a model where those terms are absent or matched. Second, the MuJoCo
`a_control` is the *constrained increment* attributable to `tau`; it equals `M^-1 tau` only when no
equality constraint or contact is active, which the run above shows by 64.77 rad/s² on a pinned tip.

**Constrained helpers.**
[`constrained_ztcf_zvcf.py`][constrained-mod] re-solves the closed-loop reaction through a KKT
projector for any provider that satisfies
[`ConstrainedEquationsOfMotionProvider`][constrained-proto] (`closure_jacobian(q)` of shape `(m, n)`
and `closure_drift(q, v)` of shape `(m,)`). It is a separate API over *equations-of-motion providers*,
not a method of `PhysicsEngine`: the MuJoCo engine above does not route through it. This page did not
enumerate which providers implement the protocol.

**Not additive over trajectories.** The split is exact at a fixed state. Integrate three forked
trajectories and the per-trajectory accelerations no longer sum to the base one
([`superposition.py`][superposition-mod]).

## PhysicsEngine Counterfactual Names Versus AffineDrift Notation {#physicsengine-counterfactual-names}

AffineDrift's [Notation Reference](notation.html) pins **ZVCF** to the pointwise control
acceleration $M^{-1}\tau$ (equivalently $M^{-1}Bu$ at $\dot q=0$ with gravity excluded from the
control operand). The `PhysicsEngine` protocol still carries an older method name that does **not** match.

| Reader goal | AffineDrift term | UpstreamDrift API at this commit | Caution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pointwise drift at fixed state | ZTCF (drift) | `compute_ztcf(q, v)` or `compute_drift_acceleration()` | At the current state the contract says they agree ([L247-L298][dyn-if-drift]); for OpenSim they are separate computations: ZTCF zeroes controls and reads `UDot` after `realizeAcceleration`, drift is `-M^-1 * bias` ([L983-L1018][os-ztcf]) |
| Pointwise control acceleration | **ZVCF** ($M^{-1}\tau$) | `compute_control_acceleration(tau)`, or `compute_control_acceleration_at_state(q, tau)` | Under MuJoCo constraints the first is the constrained increment, the second is `M^-1 tau` |
| Same ZVCF in simulation backends | **ZVCF** ($M^{-1}\tau$) | [`simulation_backends/ztcf_zvcf.py`][ztcf-mod] | Canonical module for the NOTATION definition |
| Zero-velocity gravity acceleration | not ZVCF | `compute_gravity_only_acceleration(q)` | Legacy diagnostic ([L233-L243][dyn-if-drift]) |
| Old `compute_zvcf(q)` | not ZVCF | Deprecated shim to the row above in MuJoCo, Pinocchio and the putting-green engine ([MuJoCo L921-L927][mj-drift]) | Drake keeps a direct gravity-only implementation ([L713-L756][drake-drift]); OpenSim and MyoSuite compute a zero-control, zero-velocity forward pass, which includes model forces or constraints ([OpenSim L1020-L1035][os-ztcf], [MyoSuite L80-L102][myo-drift]) |

Calling `compute_zvcf(q)` and labeling the result "ZVCF" will not reconstruct
$\ddot q \approx a_{\mathrm{ZTCF}}+a_{\mathrm{ZVCF}}$ under AffineDrift notation.

## Integrator, Timestep, and Contact Defaults {#integrator-defaults}

`step()` with no argument advances a different amount in each engine. Always pass `dt` explicitly when
comparing engines or publishing trajectories.

| Engine | Default step when `dt` is `None` | Integrator | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Suite constant | 0.001 s (`DEFAULT_TIME_STEP`) | Not applicable | [constants.py L99-L101][constants] |
| MuJoCo | `model.opt.timestep` from the loaded MJCF; a given `dt` temporarily overrides it for one step | Whatever the MJCF sets. `generated/golfer.xml`: 0.002 s, `RK4` ([L4][golfer-xml]). `simple_pendulum.xml`: 0.01 s, no `integrator` attribute ([L3][pend-xml]), so the MuJoCo default applies (an external MuJoCo fact, not read in UpstreamDrift) | [step L226-L239][mj-step] |
| Drake | `plant.time_step()`, which is the constructor argument `time_step`, default 0.001 s; passed to `AddMultibodyPlantSceneGraph`, so the plant is discrete | The code sets none; Drake's `Simulator` default applies via `AdvanceTo` | [L96-L111][drake-init], [L212-L221][drake-step] |
| Pinocchio | `DEFAULT_TIME_STEP`, 0.001 s, a module constant (not per model) | `integrator` attribute defaults to `"rk4"`; `"semi_implicit"` (symplectic Euler) is the other option; per-call override with `step(dt, integrator=...)` | [L68-L69][pin-init], [L92-L104][pin-init], [L221-L248][pin-step] |
| OpenSim | `_time_step = 0.01` s | `opensim.Manager.integrate`; integrator not set in this code | [L83][os-init], [L260-L278][os-step] |
| MyoSuite | Ignored: a differing `dt` triggers a warning; the step is `env.step(action)`. `_dt` is 0.002 until a model loads, then `model.opt.timestep` | Environment-defined | [L27][myo-init], [L35-L58][myo-core], [L87][myo-init] |
| Pendulum | 0.01 s | RK4 in `DoublePendulumDynamics.step` | [L134-L142][pend-step], [L506-L545][pend-damp] |
| Putting green | `DT_S`, 0.002 s | No integration: trajectory planned once by `simulate_ball`, then sampled | [L125-L131][putt-step], [solver.py L90][putt-dt] |
| JaxSim | `model.time_step` when present, else 0.0 | JaxSim `model.step` | [L241-L259][jax-step] |
| `ode`, `mujoco`, `mjwarp`, `mjx` backends | None: `rollout(controls, horizon, dt)` takes `dt` | `ode`: analytical RK4 | [README L13-L30][sb-readme-map], [L55-L67][sb-readme-usage] |

### Contact Parameters

- MuJoCo reports its contact model as `soft_constraint_pgs` ([capabilities L140-L144][mj-caps]).
  Generated golf MJCF uses default geoms with `condim="3"` and `friction="0.9 0.005 0.0001"`, and default joints with
  `damping="0.5"` and `armature="0.01"` ([models_advanced.py L51-L54][models-adv], [urdf_parser.py L47-L52][urdf-parser]).
  Bundled MyoSuite golf foot spheres use `solref="2e-05 2"` and `friction="0.9 0.8 0"` ([L23][myo-foot-xml]).
- Drake reports `hydroelastic_or_point_contact` ([L315-L319][drake-caps]). No contact parameter is set in the engine
  constructor read here.
- Pinocchio reports `contact_forces=NONE` ([L149-L161][pin-caps]); its `compute_contact_forces` returns zeros unless
  `set_contact_samples` was used ([L442-L467][pin-contact]).
- The cross-engine penetration tolerances are test constants: 5e-3 m for MuJoCo and 1e-3 m for the rigid
  case ([`test_contact_cross_engine.py` L46-L47][contact-test]), described in
  [`docs/conventions/contact_models.md`][contact-doc].
- The model defaults above are not engine defaults. `condim`, `friction`, and damping come from the MJCF a model supplies.

## Choosing an Engine {#engine-selection}

The table below is read from each engine's `get_capabilities()` (F = `FULL`, P = `PARTIAL`, N = `NONE`;
an unset field defaults to `NONE` ([capabilities.py L223-L230][caps-defaults])). It reflects what the code
declares, which differs from the prose matrix in `docs/engines/engine_capabilities.md` in places (for example,
MyoSuite's `get_capabilities` does not set `drift_acceleration`).

| Engine | Mass matrix | Jacobian | Contact forces | Inverse dynamics | Drift | Muscles | Other declared |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MuJoCo ([L119-L145][mj-caps]) | F | F | F | F | F | N | contact step F |
| Drake ([L300-L320][drake-caps]) | F | F | F | F | F | N | contact step F, state/control gradients F, parameter gradients P, trajectory optimization F |
| Pinocchio ([L149-L161][pin-caps]) | F | F | **N** | F | F | N | |
| OpenSim ([L97-L131][os-caps]) | F | F | P | F | **P** | F | Muscle or torque control |
| MyoSuite ([L73-L96][myo-caps]) | P | P | P | **N** | **N (unset)** | F | Activation-driven; contact step F |
| JaxSim ([L450-L467][jax-caps]) | F | F | P | F | P | N | Parameter and state/control gradients F, trajectory optimization P |
| Pendulum ([L83-L93][pend-caps]) | F | F | N | F | F | N | 2 DOF |
| Putting green ([L93-L106][putt-caps]) | F | F | P | F | F | N | Contact step F, point-mass ball |
| Simscape adapter ([L636-L641][simscape-caps]) | N | N | N | N | N | N | Drift and control raise `NotImplementedError` |

Decision guide, each line tied to the table or sections above:

| Need | Engine to start from | Reason from the code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Drift or control with ground contact, welds or grip constraints | MuJoCo | Only MuJoCo declares full contact forces together with a drift that includes constraints; know that its drift is not the rigid-body bias |
| Drift as pure `M^-1 (-bias)` for cross-engine comparison | Drake or Pinocchio | Their drift path contains no contact, constraint or damping term |
| Rigid-body dynamics without contact | Pinocchio | `contact_forces` is `NONE`; its drift is `aba` with zero torque |
| Gradients, trajectory optimization | Drake (declared F); JaxSim for parameter gradients (declared F) | `get_capabilities` fields |
| Muscle-driven models | OpenSim or MyoSuite | Only these declare `muscles=FULL`; OpenSim drift is `PARTIAL`, MyoSuite has no inverse dynamics and no declared drift |
| Teaching, double pendulum | Pendulum engine or `ode` backend | No optional dependency; run in [Runnable Examples](#minimal-usage) |
| Many parallel rollouts | `mjwarp` (non-differentiable) or `mjx` (differentiable) | Backend table below; a single 2-DOF rollout is slower on GPU per the backend README |
| Drift or control on a Simscape model | None through this protocol | Adapter raises `NotImplementedError` |

Support tiers (Supported, Extended, Experimental) are release-gate policy, not capability;
they are listed in [Engines and Runtime Support](../models/programming/engines.html). UpstreamDrift's own
[selection guide][sel-guide] and [capability matrix][cap-doc] were not re-verified line by line for this page.

## Cross-Engine Validation {#cross-engine-validation}

[`CrossEngineValidator`][validator] compares two arrays by **maximum absolute deviation** against a
per-metric tolerance (Guideline P3). The deviation is absolute, not relative
([`compare_states` L500-L568][validator-compare]). A shape mismatch fails with an infinite deviation.

| Metric key | Tolerance | Unit (code comment) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | 1e-6 | m |
| `velocity` | 1e-5 | m/s |
| `acceleration` | 1e-4 | m/s² |
| `torque` | 1e-3 | N·m |
| `jacobian` | 1e-8 | dimensionless |
| `state_round_trip` | 1e-9 | canonical-v2 state remap identity |
| `end_effector` | 5e-3 | m (v1 parity target) |
| `mass` | 1e-9 | kg |
| `center_of_mass` | 1e-9 | m |
| `inertia` | 1e-9 | kg·m² |

Source: [`TOLERANCES` L231-L242][validator-tol]. A separate torque comparison, `compare_torques_with_rms`,
passes when the RMS difference is below a percentage threshold, default 10% ([L677-L757][validator-rms]).

**Severity** (`deviation / tolerance`): at most 0.8 is `PASSED`; above 0.8 up to 1.0 is `WARNING` and still passes; above 1.0 up
to 10 is `ERROR` and fails; **above 10 is `BLOCKER`** and fails ([`_classify_severity` L570-L608][validator-sev]).
The constant `BLOCKER_THRESHOLD = 100` ([L244-L248][validator-tol]) appears only in the BLOCKER message text and the
constructor invariant; it does not set the boundary the classifier applies.

**Checks implemented as `validate_*` methods:** state round trip ([L284][validator-checks]), forward kinematics
against reference poses (L310), inverse-to-forward dynamics consistency (L337), post-export mass properties (L374), and
differential comparison against a reference engine (L403). Checks that need a capability or method the adapter does
not advertise are skipped, not failed, unless the capability query itself raises.

**Registered divergences.** A deviation that fails its tolerance fails the check unless a
[`DivergenceEntry`][validator-registry] (`id`, `check_name`, `metric_name`, an engine pair, its own `tolerance`,
and a `rationale`) matches it and the deviation stays within that entry's tolerance
([`enforce_divergence_registry` L438-L498][validator-enforce]). The registry loads from YAML via
`DivergenceRegistry.from_yaml`; UpstreamDrift keeps one at
[`docs/conformance/canonical_core_divergences.yaml`][divergence-yaml].

**Compare command** for the golf double-pendulum backends (flags `--engines --horizon --dt --output` are
documented in the [README][sb-readme-compare]; `--controls`, `--control-dim`, `--initial-q`, `--initial-v`,
`--format` and `--export-rrd` also exist in [`compare_cli.py`][compare-cli]):

```bash
python -m src.shared.python.simulation_backends.compare_cli \
  --engines ode,mujoco --horizon 200 --dt 0.005 --output reports/ode_vs_mujoco.md
```

This command was not executed for this page.

## Simulation Backends (`ode`, `mujoco`, `mjwarp`, `mjx`) {#simulation-backends}

These implement `SimulationBackend` for the shared `GolfModelParams` club model, orthogonal to full
`PhysicsEngine` loads, and are the lowest-friction path to reproduce double-pendulum ZTCF and ZVCF analysis
([README L13-L39][sb-readme-map]).

| Backend | Device | Batched | Differentiable | Exposes `M`, bias |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ode` | CPU | no | no | yes |
| `mujoco` | CPU | no | no | yes |
| `mjwarp` | CUDA | yes | no | no |
| `mjx` | JAX | yes | yes | no |

`make_backend(name, params, **kwargs)` is the factory ([`factory.py`][factory]); requesting a backend whose extra
is missing raises `BackendNotAvailableError` with an install hint. The pointwise ZTCF and ZVCF helpers
consume canonical-v2 trajectory samples and do not integrate a counterfactual rollout
([README L76-L110][sb-readme-ztcf]).

## Not Defined or Not Verified {#not-verified}

- The `Checkpointable` signatures, the lower-body model `SPEC.md`, and the model inventory in
  `src/engines/model_inventory.py` were not read for this page.
- Drake and OpenSim spatial-Jacobian row order was not read; the suite convention is `[angular; linear]`
  ([capabilities.py L28-L36][spatial-order]) and MuJoCo, Pinocchio and JaxSim were read to follow it.
- Whether OpenSim and JaxSim drift include contact or constraint forces was not determined.
- No integrator is set in the Drake, OpenSim or MyoSuite engine code; the defaults belong to those libraries.
- Which providers implement `ConstrainedEquationsOfMotionProvider` was not enumerated.
- UpstreamDrift tile IDs and CLI flags for launching each engine were not read.
